title: Muraja'ah: An-Naba' 1 to 24 with madd: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
unit: Summer 1: An-Naba' and Al-Qadr as a model
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 41 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Muraja'ah rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 41. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

arabic.text: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَٰتًۭا (١٧) يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًۭا (١٨) وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًۭا (١٩) وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا (٢٠) إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًۭا (٢١) لِّلطَّٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًۭا (٢٢) لَّٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًۭا (٢٣) لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًۭا وَلَا شَرَابًا (٢٤)

keywords.def: lengthening a vowel by set counts

questions.q: Chain recitation of 78:1 to 24, one ayah per pupil.
Rota: today's group recites 78:1 to 24 to the teacher. Everyone else: 3-3-link their weakest ayat and log them.
Extend: recite 78:17 to 24 at a steady pace with even madd.

questions.a: A) muttasil. Madd and hamza in the same word.

questions.q: Recite An-Naba' 78:21 in your head. How does the next ayah begin?
Think again: Many ayat of An-Naba' end in '-aa'. How can that help or trip up your memory?
questions.a: The rhyme helps the flow, but similar endings can make you jump to the wrong ayah: link each ayah to its meaning.
